ledger.claim: The route deviation is established on this trip's own trace. EV-GPS-02855 measures trace_distance_km at 23.41 km against the booked optimal of 17.6 km on EV-TRIP-02855, an excess of 5.81 km and 33.01%, so both POL-RD-01 gates are passed: the excess is greater than 20% of the optimal and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The governing figure is the trace; trip_record.actual_distance_km (23.4) is a rounded convenience copy and is not cited for the threshold test.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes, so the excess does not need independent corroboration. EV-GPS-02855 carries 184 fixes at a 10-second interval with 100% coverage, no gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 all fail: there is no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m and no sampling interval above 30 seconds. POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged and the excess may be taken from the trace alone.

No traffic advisory supports the driver's account, and I disclose the impairment in citing it: EV-ADVIS-02855-01 is on the bundle but its admissibility status is MISSING, its payload is null, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired, so the artifact can carry no fact and its absence is the only thing it evidences. The advisory check derived on EV-GPS-02855 returns an empty advisories list, so POL-RD-03's requirement of an advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses cannot be met and exoneration is unavailable.

POL-RD-13 confines the driver's external-traffic assertion to the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else, and there is no such artifact. Under POL-RD-13(2) the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08, it neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal route, and the deviation stands at the measured 5.81 km with POL-RD-02 running against the booked optimal of 17.6 km.

ledger.claim: The refund is then arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 17.6 + 0.28 x 23.8) x the surge multiplier of 1.0, read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN and not from the trip record) + 0.80 platform fee = 24.4640, against a charged_total of 30.69, giving 6.2260 and a payable figure of 6.25 rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05. The fare model on EV-FARE-02855 is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs.

The refund is a partial one. 6.25 is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so POL-RD-02's de minimis rule does not reduce the outcome to NO_ACTION, and it is 20.29% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a FULL_REFUND. PARTIAL_REFUND is what the arithmetic yields.

The rider carries no heightened burden on this record. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the 4-claim trigger in POL-RD-08 that would demand corroboration beyond the gps_trace is not met; these are the only rider profile counters POL-RD-08 permits either side to cite, and POL-GEN-01 confines the use of the profile to that test.

The burden has shifted to the driver under POL-RD-08 and he has nothing to discharge it with. The rider has shown the excess on a clean trace; the only artifacts capable of carrying an exculpatory route are EV-CHAT-02855, which holds 0 messages so a rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 cannot run and POL-RD-14 is not reached, and EV-ADVIS-02855-01, which is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0. ledger.claim: The driver's counterparty statement asserts a PIE closure and specifically cites LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02855-01. That advisory is in the bundle but its admissibility status is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13(1), because the driver cited the specific missing identifier, POL-RD-10(5) is engaged: an exculpatory clause (POL-RD-03) is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool. The case must therefore ESCALATE to a human reviewer, and no monetary refund issues.

The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02855) is COMPLETE with weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The trace establishes an excess of 5.81 km and 33.01% over the optimal 17.6 km. That excess exceeds the POL-RD-01 establishment thresholds (0.8 km and 20%) but falls below the materiality thresholds (8.0 km and 50%). Therefore, POL-RD-06 is not triggered: no repeat deviation pattern check, no FULL_REFUND uplift, and no conduct referral. The maximum distance-related refund under POL-RD-02 is a partial refund of 6.25 SGD, which is well below the 90% full-refund share.

The driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d = 0 and completed_trips_90d = 278. Under POL-RD-06, no pattern is established because deviation_flags_90d is below 3 and the ratio 0/278 is below 0.05. Therefore, no uplift or referral is available.

If the case is not escalated, the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02855) shows the trip was METERED and the charged total was 30.69 SGD. The recomputed fare under POL-RD-02 is 24.464 SGD, producing a refund of 6.25 SGD. That refund is a partial refund, not the full amount claimed, and is above the 0.50 SGD de minimis threshold. The rider's claim for 8.50 SGD is therefore overstated by the policy arithmetic.

Under POL-GEN-03, ESCALATE is terminal and replaces the ruling: no monetary outcome issues, and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. That preserves the present payment state for the driver, who has not been paid any refund yet (refund_issued_sgd = 0.0).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute is ESCALATED to a human reviewer under POL-RD-10(5). Escalation is terminal and replaces the ruling, so no refund and no payment issue today: the SGD 30.69 charge on EV-FARE-02855 is held (not collected, not refunded), and the SGD 8.50 in dispute is held with it.

Why escalation. The driver's statement explains the route by saying 'PIE was closed' and expressly cites LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-02855-01. That artifact is in the bundle but is MISSING: status MISSING, payload null, weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (POL-GEN-02(3) — a missing artifact can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable). POL-RD-13 tests an external-traffic assertion against the trip's traffic advisory, and it states that where the asserting party does cite the missing identifier, POL-RD-10(5) is not narrowed. The driver positively cited EV-ADVIS-02855-01, so POL-RD-03 (a driver-favouring exculpatory clause) is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool: that is the POL-RD-10(5) trigger. The driver's point that escalation preserves the present payment state (refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is correct.

What the record shows. The trace EV-GPS-02855 is NOT impaired for policy purposes: 184 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, so limbs (a)–(c) of POL-RD-07 all fail and POL-RD-10(3) is not in play — the escalation rests on (5) alone. On that trace the trip measured 23.41 km against the booked optimal of 17.6 km (EV-TRIP-02855): excess 5.81 km / 33.0%, above both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (>0.8 km and >20%) but below both materiality gates (8.0 km, 50%), so no POL-RD-06 uplift and no conduct referral arises (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0 over 278 completed trips). EV-CHAT-02855 holds 0 messages, so there is no POL-RD-04 rider-requested-detour exoneration, and the billed 23.4 km is only 0.01 km short of the trace, so no POL-RD-04 driver compensation. The rider's evidence-based points are accepted: the deviation is established on a clean trace, no advisory on file supports the driver, and the rider's counters (deviation_claims_60d 0, deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 0) impose no heightened burden. They do not move the outcome, because escalation replaces the money ruling.

What would have been paid, for transparency. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02855), so had the case been decidable the POL-RD-02 arithmetic would be ((3.80 + 0.75 x 17.6 + 0.28 x 23.8) x 1.0 surge, read from the FARE_BREAKDOWN and nowhere else) + 0.80 platform fee = 24.4640, against charged_total 30.69, i.e. 6.2260, rounded up to 6.25 — a PARTIAL_REFUND of 6.25, above the 0.50 de minimis and 20.29% of charged (well below the 90% full-refund share), not the 8.50 claimed. That arithmetic is not reached today.

What evidence would resolve it. The reviewer needs the actual LTA advisory for this trip's window — EV-ADVIS-02855-01 produced in full, showing the segment it names, its validity window and the shortest lawful alternative distance — so POL-RD-03 can be tested. If no such advisory exists, the driver's assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and the POL-RD-02 figure above (6.25 payable) would apply against the booked 17.6 km optimal.

Confidence. The escalation rests on the driver's own statement, which carries no weight_multiplier and so enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the POL-GEN-02(2) cap, and on the admissibility record of EV-ADVIS-02855-01, a MISSING artifact that can carry no fact; no weighted artifact carries the deciding fact against the case, so confidence is not dragged down by the bundle. 0.9.

Referrals. None. No clause produces a referral on these facts: POL-RD-06(c) needs a material substantiated deviation (not present) and POL-RD-09(4) needs an unmatched gantry or a wrongly applied surcharge (erp_gantries is empty and no airport surcharge was charged), so the referrals list is empty.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
